EM-45
ENGINE MECHANICAL (2JZ-GTE) - CYLINDER HEAD
EM0AL-02
REASSEMBLY
HINT:
• Thoroughly clean all parts to be assembled.
• Before installing the parts, apply fresh engine oil to all slid-
ing and rotating surfaces.
• Replace all gaskets and oil seals with new ones.

Adhesive Width
2 - 3 mm
Adhesive
10 mm
P02185

1. INSTALL HEATER UNION
HINT:
When using a new cylinder head, a new heater union must be
installed.
(a) Apply adhesive to the end of the heater union as shown
in the illustration.
Adhesive:
Part No. 08833-00070, THREE BOND 1324
or equivalent

Protrusion
P02451 Z08040

(b) Using a wooden block and hammer, tap in a new heater
union, leaving standard position protruding from the cylin-
der head.
Standard protrusion:
48 mm (1.89 in.)
NOTICE:
Do not tap it in too far.

(4) (3) (2) (1)
P12307

2. INSTALL VALVES
(a) Install a new oil seal on the valve guide bushing.
(b) Install these parts:
(1) Valve
(2) Spring seat
(3) Valve spring
(4) Spring retainer

Upward
Wide
Narrow
EM0645

NOTICE:
Confirm the correct direction of the valve spring.
